title: Community Reminder on Projects and Tokens with Similar Names
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance aims to support a diverse array of projects and tokens to meet user demands. Given the decentralized nature of cryptocurrencies, there may be instances where tokens with similar names and symbols are listed. Please note that Binance has listed Spot and Futures pairs for Sonic (S, formerly FTM), and only Futures pairs for Sonic SVM (SONIC).  Sonic (S) and Sonic SVM (SONIC) are different projects.   Sonic (S)  is an EVM layer-1 platform that offers developers attractive incentives and powerful infrastructure.  Sonic (S) has recently rebranded from Fantom (FTM) . Sonic SVM (SONIC)  is the first chain extension on Solana for games, applications, and industry’s first TikTok App Layer. To assist users in distinguishing these two projects, we have added reminder labels to their respective trading pages on Binance. Trading Pages Sonic (S):  Spot  /  Futures Sonic SVM (SONIC):  Futures   Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-01-17
